Sorigul -- Third-Party Notices
================================

This installation of Sorigul bundles the following third-party components
in addition to Sorigul's own code. This file is installed alongside the
application (C:\Program Files\Sorigul\THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt) and is
removed together with the rest of the installed program files on
uninstall -- it does not affect, and is not affected by, user data under
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Sorigul.


1. FFmpeg
---------

Component:       FFmpeg (bundled as `binaries\ffmpeg.exe`)
Exact build:     ffmpeg version 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev
                 (identified directly from this bundled binary's own
                 `ffmpeg -version` / `ffmpeg -L` output; not assumed)
Build source:    Windows builds provided by Gyan Doshi, published at
                 https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
Upstream project: https://ffmpeg.org/  (source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg)
License:         GNU General Public License, version 3 (GPLv3)

License determination: this bundled binary's own `-L` output (see
`ffmpeg -L`) states it was configured with `--enable-gpl --enable-version3`
and prints the GPLv3 notice directly -- the license below was identified
from the binary itself, not assumed or guessed between GPL/LGPL.

Full license text: see `licenses\ffmpeg-gpl-3.0.txt` in this same
directory -- the official GNU General Public License v3 text, downloaded
verbatim from the Free Software Foundation at
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt (the canonical publication of
this license, not a third-party copy).

Source code availability: FFmpeg's complete corresponding source code is
publicly available at all times, at no charge, from the FFmpeg project
itself (https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg and https://ffmpeg.org/download.html)
and from the Windows-build provider whose build is bundled here
(https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/, which also documents the exact
build configuration and any patches applied). This notice, together with
those publicly-accessible locations, constitutes Sorigul's offer of
access to the Corresponding Source as permitted under GPLv3 section 6(d)
(the source being already publicly available via the same means).

No modification was made to FFmpeg's source or to this binary by the
Sorigul project; it is redistributed unmodified.


2. imageio-ffmpeg
-----------------

Component:       imageio-ffmpeg (Python packaging-time dependency used to
                 provision the FFmpeg binary above during the build --
                 imageio-ffmpeg's own Python code is NOT bundled into the
                 installed application; only the FFmpeg binary it
                 provided is)
Version:         0.6.0
Project:         https://github.com/imageio/imageio-ffmpeg
License:         BSD 2-Clause License

Full license text: see `licenses\imageio-ffmpeg-bsd-2-clause.txt` in this
same directory -- copied verbatim from the installed package's own
`imageio_ffmpeg-0.6.0.dist-info\LICENSE` file (the package's own bundled
license file, not a third-party copy).


Provenance summary
-------------------

Every license text and version string in this notice was taken from one
of: (a) the exact bundled binary's own `-version`/`-L` output, (b) the
exact installed Python package's own metadata/license file, or (c) the
license-issuing organization's own canonical publication (gnu.org for
GPLv3). No license text here was copied from a blog, forum, or other
secondary/unofficial source.
